\[
\sqrt{x^3y}=\sqrt{x^2\cdot xy}=|x|\sqrt{xy},\qquad \sqrt{xy^3}=\sqrt{y^2\cdot xy}=|y|\sqrt{xy}.
\]
So
\[
\sqrt{9xy}-2\sqrt{x^3y}+\sqrt{xy^3}
=3\sqrt{xy}-2|x|\sqrt{xy}+|y|\sqrt{xy}
=(3-2|x|+|y|)\sqrt{xy}.
\]
With \(x=-\frac12,\ y=-8\), \(|x|=\frac12,\ |y|=8,\ xy=4\), hence
\[
(3-1+8)\sqrt{4}=10\cdot 2=20.
\]

\[
\boxed{20}
